MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH p, strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS birth
WHERE (CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) <= 62
   OR p.birth_date = '1997/8/7'
   OR (p.college IS NOT NULL AND p.college <> 'Oregon State University')
   OR CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 2)
RETURN p.draft_pick AS col1,
       date_diff('year', birth, strptime('2026/10/14', '%Y/%m/%d')) -
       CASE WHEN date_part('month', birth) > 10
                  OR (date_part('month', birth) = 10 AND date_part('day', birth) > 14)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS col2,
       p.position AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player
